sname: 映画のワンシーン・応用編
title: 映画のワンシーン・応用編

items.en: Hey, I figured you'd be asleep by now, with the movers coming at seven.
items.jp: ねえ、引っ越し業者が7時に来るから、もう寝てると思ってたよ。
items.speak: Hey, I figured you'd be asleep by now, with the movers coming at seven.

items.en: Gimme a break. I've been doing this alone for two weeks.
items.jp: 勘弁してよ。2週間、一人でやってきたんだから。
items.speak: Gimme a break. I've been doing this alone for two weeks.
items.note: 元の形: give me／聞こえ方: ギミ／使う場面:勘弁してと頼む時

items.en: Don't make it weird. I'm just saying it's okay to be scared.
items.jp: 変な空気にしないで。怖がっていいって言ってるだけだよ。
items.speak: Don't make it weird. I'm just saying it's okay to be scared.

items.en: You're really gonna walk through those doors and leave me standing here?
items.jp: 本当にあのドアを通って、私をここに立たせたままにするの？
items.speak: You're really gonna walk through those doors and leave me standing here?
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:驚きと不満を伝える時

items.en: It's not forever, y'know. It's two years, and we'll talk every single day.
items.jp: 永遠じゃないんだよ、ほら。2年だけだし、毎日話すよ。
items.speak: It's not forever, y'know. It's two years, and we'll talk every single day.
items.note: 元の形: you know／聞こえ方: ヤノウ／使う場面:念を押す時

items.en: Probably. Now go, before I change my mind and chain myself to your suitcase.
items.jp: たぶんね。さあ行って、気が変わってスーツケースに自分をつなぎとめる前に。
items.speak: Probably. Now go, before I change my mind and chain myself to your suitcase.

items.en: Let's cut to the chase. Your quote's fifteen percent higher than the other bids.
items.jp: 単刀直入にいこう。御社の見積もりは、他の入札より15%高い。
items.speak: Let's cut to the chase. Your quote's fifteen percent higher than the other bids.

items.en: Five isn't gonna cut it. Ten, and we shake hands right now.
items.jp: 5%では足りない。10%なら、今すぐ握手する。
items.speak: Five isn't gonna cut it. Ten, and we shake hands right now.
items.note: 元の形: is not going to／聞こえ方: ゴナ／使う場面:断りを伝える時

items.en: Lemme step out and make a call. Give me five minutes.
items.jp: 席を外して電話させて。5分ください。
items.speak: Lemme step out and make a call. Give me five minutes.
items.note: 元の形: let me／聞こえ方: レミ／使う場面:席を外す前に

items.en: That's the absolute final offer, and I can't do any better without my boss.
items.jp: それが本当に最終提案で、上司なしにはこれ以上できません。
items.speak: That's the absolute final offer, and I can't do any better without my boss.

items.en: Can you put that in writing, including the warranty and the delivery date?
items.jp: それを、保証と納期も含めて、書面にしてもらえますか？
items.speak: Can you put that in writing, including the warranty and the delivery date?

items.en: Mind if I sit here? Everywhere else is taken, and I've been on my feet all night.
items.jp: ここに座ってもいい？ほかは全部埋まってて、夜通し立ちっぱなしなんだ。
items.speak: Mind if I sit here? Everywhere else is taken, and I've been on my feet all night.
items.note: 元の形: do you mind／聞こえ方: マインディフ／使う場面:許可を軽くとる時

items.en: We'll let you know when we know. I swear I've heard that line a hundred times.
items.jp: 分かり次第お知らせします。その言葉は百回は聞いたよ。
items.speak: We'll let you know when we know. I swear I've heard that line a hundred times.

items.en: I got two coffees, and I really only needed one. Here, take it.
items.jp: コーヒーを2つ買ったけど、本当は1つで足りるんだ。どうぞ、受け取って。
items.speak: I got two coffees, and I really only needed one. Here, take it.

items.en: Don't worry, they'll call you soon. They always do.
items.jp: 心配しないで、すぐ呼ばれるよ。いつもそうだから。
items.speak: Don't worry, they'll call you soon. They always do.

items.en: Sorry to bother you this late. I'm from 4B, right below you.
items.jp: 遅くにすみません。真下の4Bの者です。
items.speak: Sorry to bother you this late. I'm from 4B, right below you.

items.en: I'm not trying to start a fight, but there's a loud thumping every night around eleven.
items.jp: けんかしたいわけじゃないんですが、毎晩11時ごろにドンドンと大きな音がするんです。
items.speak: I'm not trying to start a fight, but there's a loud thumping every night around eleven.

items.en: Better to say something than stew about it for months, right?
items.jp: 何か月も悶々とするより、言った方がいいよね？
items.speak: Better to say something than stew about it for months, right?

items.en: Hey, if it's still loud, just knock, and we'll figure it out together.
items.jp: もしまだうるさかったら、ノックして。一緒に考えよう。
items.speak: Hey, if it's still loud, just knock, and we'll figure it out together.

items.en: Is that really you? Wow, it's been what, six years?
items.jp: 本当に君？わあ、もう何年ぶり、6年？
items.speak: Is that really you? Wow, it's been what, six years?

items.en: You look exactly the same. Liar, I've got twice as much gray hair.
items.jp: 全然変わってないですね。嘘つき、白髪は倍になったよ。
items.speak: You look exactly the same. Liar, I've got twice as much gray hair.

items.en: I always said you were wasted in that cubicle, and honestly, I meant it.
items.jp: 君はあの小部屋にいるには惜しいといつも言ってたし、本気だったよ。
items.speak: I always said you were wasted in that cubicle, and honestly, I meant it.

items.en: Let me buy you a coffee tomorrow. I'd love to hear the whole story.
items.jp: 明日コーヒーをおごらせて。一部始終を聞きたいんだ。
items.speak: Let me buy you a coffee tomorrow. I'd love to hear the whole story.
items.note: 元の形: let me／聞こえ方: レミ／使う場面:申し出る時

items.en: I'd hire you tomorrow, no questions asked.
items.jp: 明日にでも雇いますよ、質問なしで。
items.speak: I'd hire you tomorrow, no questions asked.

items.en: Honestly, I didn't see that coming, and I'm still kinda in shock.
items.jp: 正直、それは予想してなくて、まだちょっとショックなんだ。
items.speak: Honestly, I didn't see that coming, and I'm still kinda in shock.
items.note: 元の形: kind of／聞こえ方: カインダ／使う場面:やんわり言う時

items.en: Whatcha gonna do about it? You can't just ignore it.
items.jp: それをどうするつもり？無視はできないよ。
items.speak: Whatcha gonna do about it? You can't just ignore it.
items.note: 元の形: what are you going to／聞こえ方: ワッチャ ガナ／使う場面:行動を聞く時

items.en: Didja really think nobody would notice? Come on.
items.jp: 本当に誰も気づかないと思った？まさか。
items.speak: Didja really think nobody would notice? Come on.
items.note: 元の形: did you／聞こえ方: ディジャ／使う場面:問いただす時

items.en: I'm not gonna lie, I was kinda hoping you'd say no.
items.jp: 正直に言うと、断ってくれないかなって少し思ってたんだ。
items.speak: I'm not gonna lie, I was kinda hoping you'd say no.

items.en: We hafta talk about what happened last night, and I mean right now.
items.jp: 昨夜のことを話さなきゃ。今すぐ。
items.speak: We hafta talk about what happened last night, and I mean right now.
items.note: 元の形: have to／聞こえ方: ハフタ／使う場面:話をうながす時

items.en: I gotta be honest with you. I don't think this is working.
items.jp: 正直に言わなきゃ。これはうまくいってないと思う。
items.speak: I gotta be honest with you. I don't think this is working.
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: ガラ／使う場面:本音を言う時

items.en: Y'know what? Forget it. I'm done arguing about this.
items.jp: いいよもう。忘れて。この件で言い合うのは終わりにする。
items.speak: Y'know what? Forget it. I'm done arguing about this.
items.note: 元の形: you know／聞こえ方: ヤノウ／使う場面:話を打ち切る時

items.en: Say what you want, but I'm not changing my mind.
items.jp: 好きに言えばいいけど、気は変わらないよ。
items.speak: Say what you want, but I'm not changing my mind.

items.en: Ya think I wanted this? I had no choice, man.
items.jp: 僕がこれを望んだと思う？選択肢がなかったんだよ。
items.speak: Ya think I wanted this? I had no choice, man.
items.note: 元の形: do you think／聞こえ方: ヤ シンク／使う場面:反論する時

items.en: Long story short, we lost the deal, and now everybody's panicking.
items.jp: 要するに、契約を落として、みんなパニックになってる。
items.speak: Long story short, we lost the deal, and now everybody's panicking.

items.en: It's not that I don't care. It's that I don't know what to say.
items.jp: 気にしてないわけじゃない。何を言えばいいか分からないだけ。
items.speak: It's not that I don't care. It's that I don't know what to say.

items.en: Wait a second. You're telling me they knew all along?
items.jp: ちょっと待って。みんな最初から知ってたって言うの？
items.speak: Wait a second. You're telling me they knew all along?

items.en: Look, I'm not the bad guy here. I'm just trying to help.
items.jp: いいかい、僕は悪者じゃない。ただ助けようとしてるだけだ。
items.speak: Look, I'm not the bad guy here. I'm just trying to help.

items.en: Beats me why he'd say that. He's never been like this.
items.jp: なんで彼があんなことを言うのか分からない。今までこんなことなかったのに。
items.speak: Beats me why he'd say that. He's never been like this.
items.note: 元の形: it beats me／聞こえ方: ビーツミー／使う場面:理由が分からない時

items.en: Couldn't tell you. I stopped asking questions a long time ago.
items.jp: 何とも言えないな。質問するのはとっくにやめたよ。
items.speak: Couldn't tell you. I stopped asking questions a long time ago.

items.en: Not gonna happen. I've said no three times already.
items.jp: それはない。もう3回断ってるんだ。
items.speak: Not gonna happen. I've said no three times already.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ノット ガナ／使う場面:きっぱり断る時

items.en: C'mon, give me a chance to explain before you hang up.
items.jp: ほら、電話を切る前に説明させてよ。
items.speak: C'mon, give me a chance to explain before you hang up.
items.note: 元の形: come on／聞こえ方: カモン／使う場面:食い下がる時

items.en: Hey, Maya, take a breath. Whatever it is, we'll sort it out.
items.jp: ねえマヤ、深呼吸して。何があっても、一緒に片づけよう。
items.speak: Hey, Maya, take a breath. Whatever it is, we'll sort it out.

items.en: Sir, with all due respect, I think there's been a misunderstanding.
items.jp: お言葉ですが、誤解があったと思います。
items.speak: Sir, with all due respect, I think there's been a misunderstanding.

items.en: Boss, you're gonna want to see this before the meeting starts.
items.jp: ボス、会議が始まる前にこれを見てほしいです。
items.speak: Boss, you're gonna want to see this before the meeting starts.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:見るよう促す時

items.en: Dude, I can't believe you actually pulled it off.
items.jp: なあ、本当にやり遂げたなんて信じられないよ。
items.speak: Dude, I can't believe you actually pulled it off.

items.en: Babe, we've talked about this. I'm not going anywhere.
items.jp: ねえ、この話はしたでしょ。私はどこにも行かないよ。
items.speak: Babe, we've talked about this. I'm not going anywhere.

items.en: Man, I wish I'd said something sooner. It's too late now.
items.jp: うわ、もっと早く言っておけばよかった。もう遅いけど。
items.speak: Man, I wish I'd said something sooner. It's too late now.

items.en: Buddy, I'm only gonna say this once, so listen carefully.
items.jp: おい、一度しか言わないから、よく聞いて。
items.speak: Buddy, I'm only gonna say this once, so listen carefully.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:念を押す時

items.en: Say again? I think I missed the part about the deadline.
items.jp: もう一度言って？締め切りの部分を聞き逃したみたい。
items.speak: Say again? I think I missed the part about the deadline.

items.en: Just talk normally. You don't have to sound like a lawyer.
items.jp: 普通に話して。弁護士みたいに話さなくていいよ。
items.speak: Just talk normally. You don't have to sound like a lawyer.
